effect.name: Rightful Reward · utility
effect.description: When the wielder is healed, restore 8/10/12/14/16 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s, and can occur even when the character is not on the field. This passive has no direct per-hit damage modifier. Combat snapshot: set the controls for this hit; durations, stack consumption, healing, energy and cooldowns are not simulated.
